context: A teacher walks a teen through cultural studies
purpose: Teach: 除け/処方/知見/養う/備える/凶/調書/力強く

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、研究、厄除けの儀式、地域差、よく調べましたね。
lines.en: Sakura, your research on ward-off rituals and regional differences was thorough.
lines.style: Warm acknowledgment, measured pace. Teacher-to-student energy: noticing real effort. Slight lean forward on the praise, steady eye contact.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。漢方医の処方、現代と比較しました。
lines.en: Yes. I compared traditional herbal remedies with modern research.
lines.style: Direct and focused, a bit breathless with the weight of the work she's done. Quiet confidence building — not rehearsed, but clearly thought through.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 昔の人々の知見、現代の研究にも、活かされていますね。
lines.en: The wisdom of people in the past — it's still alive in modern research, isn't it.
lines.style: Gentle observation, almost musing. Slight pause before 'still alive' — finding the right words. Warm, validating what Sakura just said.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。家族を養う伝統的役割、時代と共に変化しました。
lines.en: Yes. The traditional family role has shifted with the times.
lines.style: Measured, slightly careful — aware she's making a bigger claim now. Speaking clearly but without overstatement. A hint of the real thought behind it.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 天変地異に備える文化、日本特有ですね。
lines.en: The culture of preparing for natural disaster — that's distinctly Japanese, isn't it.
lines.style: Quiet wonder underlying this. Not lecturing — thinking out loud with Sakura. Pace is unhurried, inviting her to sit with the observation.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。凶事を避ける民間信仰、各地で観察しました。
lines.en: Yes. I observed folk beliefs about warding off misfortune across different regions.
lines.style: Steady, grounded. The voice of someone who's spent time listening to real people. No performance — just reporting what she learned, with quiet pride in having done the work.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 地元の方の調書、フィールドノート、貴重ですね。
lines.en: The records from local residents, your field notes — those are invaluable.
lines.style: Genuine appreciation, almost tender. Recognition that Sakura did something that mattered — went out and listened. Slight emphasis on 'invaluable,' but not overstated.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。地方の人々が力強く生きる姿、伝えたいです。
lines.en: Yes. I want to show how the people in these places live with such strength.
lines.style: Soft but firm conviction. The voice of someone reaching for something important. Slight tremor of caring underneath, quickly steadied. Trailing off gently — leaving room for what comes next.
